title: Certificate of Extremely Specific Expertise
subject: ONE SUBJECT, EXHAUSTIVELY
citation: for a depth of knowledge on a single topic that exceeds that of every adult in the building, and for sharing it without being asked.

title: Certificate of Continuous Enquiry
subject: BUT WHY THOUGH
citation: for asking the question the rest of the room was also wondering about, and for the follow-up question that nobody had prepared for.

title: Certificate of the Comprehensive Answer
subject: IT STARTED IN 1847
citation: for responding to a question requiring one word with an account that began considerably earlier and covered substantially more ground.

title: Certificate of Recurring Pencil Loss
subject: IT WAS HERE A MINUTE AGO
citation: for the disappearance of writing implements at a rate that has begun to interest the school, and for locating each one eventually.

title: Certificate of Advanced Snack Diplomacy
subject: AN EVEN TRADE
citation: for negotiations conducted daily at the lunch table, and for a trading record that has never once ended in an incident.

title: Certificate of Meteorological Commentary
subject: IT'S RAINING AGAIN
citation: for continuous reporting on conditions outside, delivered promptly and without regard for whether the lesson had finished.

title: Certificate of Steady Bookmark Advancement
subject: ONE MORE CHAPTER
citation: for reading past the point where reading was supposed to stop, and for carrying the same book to places books do not need to go.

title: Certificate of Distinguished Line Leadership
subject: AT THE FRONT, AGAIN
citation: for arriving at the door before the instruction to line up had finished, on every occasion, for an entire academic year.

title: Certificate of Handwriting Under Pressure
subject: THE LAST FOUR MINUTES
citation: for maintaining legibility through the closing stage of every written task, at a speed the paper was not designed to accommodate.

title: Certificate of Unprompted Assistance
subject: NOBODY ASKED
citation: for noticing that someone needed help before anyone said so, and for not mentioning it afterwards. Repeatedly. Without being told.

title: Certificate of the Unscheduled Fact
subject: DID YOU KNOW
citation: for the delivery of accurate and genuinely interesting information at moments bearing no relationship whatsoever to the lesson in progress.

title: Certificate of Completing the Year
subject: ALL OF IT
citation: for attending, participating, growing measurably taller, and reaching the end of the year having made the room better by being in it.
